PROCEDURE entry_details IS
 v_blood_type VARCHAR2(5);
 v_veni VARCHAR2(50);

 CURSOR veni_cur is select attrib_value from donation_attributes where 
 transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id and attrib_code='VENI';
 v_ssn number;
BEGIN
 go_block('don_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 go_block('dnr_block');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 declare
 ---
 cursor c1 is /*international address 4/6/11 starts*/
 select a.last_name,a.last_name_suffix,a.first_name,a.middle_name,
 a.alternate_id_type,a.alternate_id, a.date_of_birth,a.gender,a.donor_weight,a.blood_type,a.ethnic_group,
 b.street_name,b.suite_apt,b.d_area_code,b.d_phone_no,b.extension,
 b.h_area_code,b.h_phone_no,
 b.m_area_code, b.m_phone_no, b.preferred_contact_flag, -- MLT 1289
 b.email,c.state,c.city,c.zip,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_1,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_2,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_3,
 b.COUNTRY_NAME,
 b.INTL_POSTAL_CODE,
 b.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO,
 b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO,
 b.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT,
 b.INTL_MOBILE_PHONE_NO,
 b.INTL_FAX_NO,
 b.INTL_ADDR_FLAG,
 b.INTL_ADDRESS_4
 from donors a,donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 where a.donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id and
 b.donor_id = a.donor_id and
 c.usps_id = NVL(b.usps_id, 0) and
 rownum = 1;

c_row c1%rowtype;
v_intl_st varchar2(500); /*international address 4/6/11 ends*/
---

 begin
 go_block('don_block');
 go_item('don_block.pb_close'); 

 :don_block.donor_id:=:parameter.p_donor_id;
 :don_block.unit_id:=:parameter.p_unit_id; 

/*international address 4/6/11 starts*/
if not c1%isopen then
 open c1;
 end if;
 fetch c1 into c_row;
 close c1;

 if c_row.INTL_ADDR_FLAG = 'Y' THEN
 --
 select (c_row.intl_address_1 ||
 decode(c_row.intl_address_2, null, null,', '|| c_row.intl_address_2) || 
 decode(c_row.intl_address_3, null, null,', '|| c_row.intl_address_3) || 
 decode(c_row.intl_address_4, null, null,', '|| c_row.intl_address_4) ||
 decode(c_row.country_name, null, null,', '|| c_row.country_name) ||
 decode(c_row.intl_postal_code, null, null,', '|| c_row.intl_postal_code)
 )
 into v_intl_st from dual;

 --
 :dnr_block.last_name := c_row.last_name;
 :dnr_block.last_name_suffix := c_row.last_name_suffix;
 :dnr_block.first_name := c_row.first_name;
 :dnr_block.middle_name := c_row.middle_name;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id_type:= c_row.alternate_id_type;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id := c_row.alternate_id;
 --v_ssn := c_row.ssn;
 :dnr_block.date_of_birth := c_row.date_of_birth;
 :dnr_block.gender := c_row.gender;
 :dnr_block.donor_weight := c_row.donor_weight;
 v_blood_type := c_row.blood_type;
 :dnr_block.ethnic_group := c_row.ethnic_group;
 :dnr_block.intl_addr := v_intl_st; --jairam changed so that intl addr is displayed on new field, not on local addr fields
 --:dnr_block.suite_apt := c_row.suite_apt;
 --:dnr_block.d_area_code := c_row.d_area_code;
 :dnr_block.d_phone_no := c_row.INTL_WORK_PHONE_NO;
 :dnr_block.extension := c_row.INTL_WORK_PHONE_EXT;
 --:dnr_block.h_area_code := c_row.h_area_code;
 :dnr_block.h_phone_no := c_row.INTL_HOME_PHONE_NO;
 :dnr_block.email := c_row.email;

 else /*international address 4/6/11 ends*/
 :dnr_block.last_name := c_row.last_name;
 :dnr_block.last_name_suffix := c_row.last_name_suffix;
 :dnr_block.first_name := c_row.first_name;
 :dnr_block.middle_name := c_row.middle_name;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id_type:= c_row.alternate_id_type;
 :dnr_block.alternate_id := c_row.alternate_id;
 --v_ssn := c_row.ssn;
 :dnr_block.date_of_birth := c_row.date_of_birth;
 :dnr_block.gender := c_row.gender;
 :dnr_block.donor_weight := c_row.donor_weight;
 v_blood_type := c_row.blood_type;
 :dnr_block.ethnic_group := c_row.ethnic_group;
 :dnr_block.street_name := c_row.street_name;
 :dnr_block.suite_apt := c_row.suite_apt;
 :dnr_block.d_area_code := c_row.d_area_code;
 :dnr_block.d_phone_no := c_row.d_phone_no;
 :dnr_block.extension := c_row.extension;
 :dnr_block.h_area_code := c_row.h_area_code;
 :dnr_block.h_phone_no := c_row.h_phone_no;
 :dnr_block.email := c_row.email;
 :dnr_block.state := c_row.state; 
 :dnr_block.city := c_row.city;
 :dnr_block.zip := c_row.zip;
 end if;


 -- MLT 1289 changes
 :dnr_block.m_area_code := c_row.m_area_code;
 :dnr_block.m_phone_no := c_row.m_phone_no; 
 :dnr_block.check_home := 'N';
 :dnr_block.check_mobile := 'N';
 :dnr_block.check_work := 'N'; 
 If c_row.preferred_contact_flag='H' then 
 :dnr_block.check_home:='Y';
 Elsif c_row.preferred_contact_flag ='W' then 
 :dnr_block.check_work:='Y';
 Elsif c_row.preferred_contact_flag='M' then 
 :dnr_block.check_mobile:='Y';
 End If;
 ----------------
 
------ 
 
 exception when no_data_found then
 null;
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 end;

 


 begin /* ABO description */
 select description into :dnr_block.blood_type from valid_master_codes where 
 code_type='ABO' and code=v_blood_type;
 exception when no_data_found then
 :dnr_block.blood_type:=v_blood_type;
 end;



begin

 select credit_sponsor,lookup_id,screener_id,physical_id,actual_rbc_loss,actual_plasma_loss
 into :don_block.credit_sponsor,:don_block.lookup_id,:don_block.screener_id,:don_block.physical_id,
 :don_block.rbc_loss,:don_block.plasma_loss from
 donations where transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id;
exception when no_data_found then

end;


begin

select donation_type,procedure_code,deferral_reason,deferred_thru_date,void_unit_id,
 decode(donor_cue,null,'Not Scanned','Done'),
 coll_date,transaction_id,first_reviewer_id,arm_used,material_id,
 equip_type
 into :don_block.donation_type,:don_block.procedure_code,:don_block.deferral_reason,
 :don_block.deferred_thru_date,:don_block.void_unit_id,:don_block.donor_cue,
 :don_block.coll_date,:don_block.transaction_id,:don_block.first_reviewer_id,

exception when no_data_found then
null;

--- Added on 05/12/2012; Ashok; IM:5460
declare
 intl_count NUMBER;
 v_empl_id VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 -- Get employer id;
 begin
 select employer_id into v_empl_id from donors where donor_id=:parameter.p_donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 null;
 end;
 
 if v_empl_id is not null then 
 select count(*) into intl_count from donor_employers where employer_id = v_empl_id and intl_city is not null;
 
 if intl_count <> 0 then -- intl address;
 begin
 select REPLACE(intl_city||', '||NVL(TRIM(intl_state),'#@#@')||', '||NVL(TRIM(intl_postal_code),'#@#@')||', ' || Intl_country_name, ', #@#@','')
 into :dnr_block.emp_intl_addr
 from DONOR_EMPLOYERS where employer_id = v_empl_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 null;
 end; 
 else -- local address
 begin
 select A.Employer_name,b.zip,b.city,b.state
 into :dnr_block.Employer_name,:dnr_block.e_zip,:dnr_block.e_city,:dnr_block.e_state
 from donor_employers a,valid_city_state b
 where a.employer_id = v_empl_id and a.usps_id = b.usps_id;
 exception
 when others then 
 null;
 end; 
 end if;
 end if; -- v_empl_id is not null;
end;

/*----------pickup reaction from donation attributes------------*/

 begin
 select attrib_value into :don_block.s_reactions from donation_attributes where
 transaction_id=:parameter.p_trans_id and attrib_code='REACT';
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 null;
 when others then
 null;
 end;

/*----------pickup veni from donation attributes------------*/ 
 begin
 if veni_cur%isopen then
 close veni_cur;
 end if;

 for veni_rec in veni_cur loop
 v_veni:=v_veni||veni_rec.attrib_value||',';
 end loop;
 :don_block.s_venipuncture:=v_veni;
 :don_block.s_venipuncture:=substr(v_veni,1,NVL(length(v_veni), 0)-1);
 end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

 END IF;
END;

-- Added by Kishore on 11/01/2011. SCR 18370
PROCEDURE ASSIGN_GLOBAL_ALT_ADDR_VARS IS
 t_multi_chapter lt_application_config.multi_chapter%type;
BEGIN
 begin
 select multi_chapter
 into t_multi_chapter
 from lt_application_config;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 t_multi_chapter := null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 begin
 select alt_street_name, alt_suite_apt, alt_usps_id,
 alt_intl_address_1, alt_intl_address_2, alt_intl_address_3,
 alt_intl_address_4, alt_country_name, alt_intl_postal_code,
 alt_intl_addr_flag, m_area_code, m_phone_no,
 other_contact_no, alt_intl_phone_no, preferred_contact_flag,

 :global.alt_intl_address_1, :global.alt_intl_address_2, :global.alt_intl_address_3,

 :global.other_contact_no, :global.alt_intl_phone_no, :global.preferred_contact_flag,
 :global.preferred_contact_addr_flag
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :parameter.p_donor_id
 and chapter_id = decode(t_multi_chapter, 'Y', chapter_id, :global.chapter_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 :global.alt_street_name := null;
 :global.alt_suite_apt := null;
 :global.alt_usps_id := null;
 :global.alt_intl_address_1 := null;

 :global.edit_flag := 'N';
END;

 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
